manifest.name: Card Search Highlight
manifest.author: CardSpoke Community
manifest.description: Adds an in-page search overlay (Ctrl+Shift+F) that highlights matching text across all visible cards with match navigation

css: .search-highlight-overlay { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.98); border-bottom: 2px solid #3498db; padding: 10px 16px; z-index: 10001; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif; } .search-highlight-overlay.hidden { display: none; } .search-highlight-input { flex: 1; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 6px; font-size: 14px; outline: none; } .search-highlight-input:focus { border-color: #3498db; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(52,152,219,0.15); } .search-highlight-info { font-size: 12px; color: #666; min-width: 80px; text-align: center; } .search-highlight-btn { padding: 6px 12px; border: 1px solid #ccc; border-radius: 4px; background: #fff; cursor: pointer; font-size: 13px; } .search-highlight-btn:hover { background: #f0f0f0; } .search-highlight-close { padding: 6px 10px; border: none; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; font-size: 18px; color: #999; } .search-highlight-close:hover { color: #333; } mark.search-match { background: rgba(255,235,59,0.5); border-radius: 2px; padding: 0 1px; } mark.search-match-active { background: rgba(255,152,0,0.7); outline: 2px solid #ff9800; } body.dark-theme .search-highlight-overlay { background: rgba(30,30,40,0.98); border-bottom-color: #5dade2; } body.dark-theme .search-highlight-input { background: #1a1a2a; border-color: #444; color: #eee; } body.dark-theme .search-highlight-btn { background: #2a2a3a; border-color: #444; color: #ccc; } body.dark-theme .search-highlight-info { color: #aaa; } body.dark-theme mark.search-match { background: rgba(255,235,59,0.3); color: #fff; } body.dark-theme mark.search-match-active { background: rgba(255,152,0,0.5); }
